description: ĢEOLatvija.lv: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ĢEOLatvija.lv. Coverage: ĢEOLatvija.lv. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Notekūdeņu novadīšanas vietas WMS; Notekūdeņu novadīšanas vietas; Notekūdeņu novadīšanas vietas WFS; Aglomerācijas (komunālie notekūdeņi). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
